ai_summary.headline: Myanmar has one of the larger MPC lines in the region at $85M, with cash share unusually high.
ai_summary.narrative: The 2026 HNRP seeks $890M for 4.9M people, 27% fewer than 2025 [s2][s4]. MPC is about $85M, roughly 9.6% of the plan [s5]; the gDCF analysis puts total CVA near $276M, about 31% [s1]. The CMWG's provisional MPC transfer is MMK 360,000 per household per month, checked against inflation twice a year with the World Bank [s1]. FTS shows $468.1M received by late October 2026, about 53% of requirements [s5]. MPC has received $58.4M against its $85.4M line, 68%, and about 12% of all funding on FTS's single-cluster view ($112.6M, 132%, if shared-cluster flows are counted) [s5]; this appears unusual and likely reflects carry-over or tagging rather than surplus cash, so it needs checking in FTS. The HNRP states a strong cash preference, but I could not verify the MSNA percentages [s1]. A national CMWG with sub-national groups is active [s6][s7]. Gaps: chairs, cash feasibility, pooled fund allocations, cost efficiency and a current market monitoring product are not confirmed. Inference: CALP may add most by checking data quality and supporting deduplication.

total_funding_usd.note: All incoming funding to the plan, pledges excluded. Matches the FTS plan summary.

mpc_usd.note: FTS single-cluster view of the Multi-Purpose Cash cluster; shared-cluster view US$58.4M. Incoming flows, pledges excluded.

ctp_usd.note: All flows tagged 'Cash transfer programming (CTP)', inside or outside the MPC cluster.

sectoral_cva_usd.note: Flows whose FTS modality field is 'Cash transfer programming (CTP)' and whose destination cluster is not multi-purpose cash: 41 flows. The CTP tag is set by the reporting donor or agency and is not applied consistently, so this is a floor, not a measure of sectoral cash. Largest: Early Recovery US$10.0M, Food Security US$6.6M, Protection US$1.6M.

cva_usd.note: Union of the MPC cluster and the CTP tag. Widest defensible FTS cash figure; still a floor because untagged sectoral cash is invisible.

sectoral_cva_pct_of_total.note: sectoral_cva_usd as a share of total plan funding.

mpc_pct_of_total.note: MPC cluster funding as a share of total plan funding (single-cluster view).

fts_cva.caveat: FTS records funding, not transfers to people, and only to first-level recipients. Sectoral cash depends on a modality tag that reporters apply unevenly.

FTS does not see sub-grants, so this understates money that reaches local actors through international intermediaries.
